name: Polycab India Ltd
read: Growth and margin targets tracking ahead; capex on track; BharatNet revenue and capex split lack recent updates.

events.label: volume growth 1.5x GDP growth full year
events.quote: FY26 volume growth 18% vs GDP ~7%, well above 1.5x.

promises.label: volume growth 1.5x GDP growth full year
promises.verdict: FY26 volume growth 18% vs GDP ~7%, well above 1.5x.

history.quote: we've always guided, we'll continue to deliver 1.5x of GDP growth
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: FMEG EBITDA margin 8-10% by FY30
promises.actual: FMEG EBIT margin 10.1% in Q2 FY27 (call); FY26 EBIT margin 12.6% (company level)
promises.evidence: Q2 FY27 call, p7; reported financials FY26
promises.verdict: FY30 target; Q2 FY27 FMEG EBIT 10.1% already in range, tracking ahead.

history.quote: progressing towards the 8%-10% EBITDA target by FY 2030
history.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya

history.quote: EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

history.quote: we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin
history.speaker: Aditya Nathany

promises.label: Project Spring capex ₹12–16 billion annually through FY30
promises.evidence: Q4 FY26 call, p4; Q2 FY27 call, p6
promises.verdict: FY26 capex ₹14.8bn within ₹12-16bn; H1 FY27 ₹6.1bn on track.

history.quote: in line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion - ₹ 16 billion annually through to FY 2030
history.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya

history.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: FMEG EBITDA margin 8-10% by FY30
promises.actual: FMEG EBIT margin 10.1% in Q2 FY27 (call)
promises.verdict: FY30 target; Q2 FY27 FMEG EBIT 10.1% already in range, tracking ahead.

history.quote: FMEG will continue to improve its profitability towards the guided range of 8% to 10% by FY30
history.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya

history.quote: we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: Bharat Net revenue ₹800-1,000 crore this year
promises.actual: BharatNet order book ~₹80bn ex-GST as of Q2 FY26
promises.verdict: FY27 target; no BharatNet revenue update since Q2 FY26, unclear.

history.quote: maybe 1/3rd of that should translate into revenue, maybe INR 800 crores to INR 1,000 crores may come from Bharat Net alone
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: FMEG 1.5x-2x market growth
promises.actual: FMEG revenue growth 124% YoY in Q2 FY27
promises.verdict: FY30 target; FMEG growing 124% YoY, well ahead of 1.5-2x market.

history.quote: whatever the market growth will deliver 1.5x to 2x of that growth
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: 1.5x market growth guidance
promises.verdict: FY27 target; 53% YoY growth suggests well above 1.5x market.

history.quote: we have always guided that we will do 1.5x of market growth, which is a mix of both volume and value
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: 1.5x market growth until FY30
promises.verdict: FY30 target; 53% YoY growth suggests well above 1.5x market.

history.quote: we have guided that we'll continue to grow at 1.5x of market growth... will continue to happen until FY30
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: FY27 T&D ~17,000 circuit km addition
promises.actual: 2,000 circuit km added in Apr-May FY27
promises.verdict: FY27 target; 2,000 of 17,000 circuit km by May, likely behind.

history.quote: This year itself in FY27, we are expecting around 17,000 circuit kilometre capacity addition
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

promises.label: 90% of Project Spring capex into Cable & Wire
promises.verdict: FY27 not over; no FY27 capex split provided to verify 90% allocation.

history.quote: around 90% of that will go into Cable & Wire capacity expansion alone. And some 5% will go into backward integration
history.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
